class.name: GDCubismUserModel
class.description: Loads and renders a Live2D Cubism model. Required native processing continues when a GDScript subclass overrides regular process callbacks. The inherited Node pause policy still applies. Runtime nodes are disposed on tree exit and recreated on reentry.

method.name: get_model_state
method.description: Returns the explicit load/teardown state.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns a copy of the latest load error containing code, path and message. Empty after a successful load or explicit unload.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: True only while a complete native model is ready.

method.name: unload_model
method.description: Releases owned runtime resources and cancels motion handles with UNLOADED. Repeated calls are safe. Retained parameter resources become invalid.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances a ready, unpaused model in MANUAL mode. Delta is in seconds. Zero and nonfinite values do not advance; negative values are ignored with a debug warning. The effective delta after speed scaling is capped at 0.1 seconds. Use multiple fixed steps for deterministic evaluation.

method.name: csm_get_latest_moc_version
method.description: Returns the latest file version that [GDCubismUserModel] can load.

method.name: csm_get_moc_version
method.description: Returns the version of the loaded [b]moc3[/b] file.

method.name: csm_get_version
method.description: Returns the version number of Cubism Native SDK Core used by GDCubism in [Dictionary] format. - [int] [b]version:[/b] The value returned by the [i]csmVersion[/i] function is stored as is. - [int] [b]major:[/b] Only the major version is extracted from version and stored. - [int] [b]minor:[/b] Only the minor version is extracted from version and stored. - [int] [b]patch:[/b] Only the patch number is extracted from version and stored.

method.name: get_canvas_info
method.description: Returns the following information in [Dictionary] format. - [Vector2] [b]size_in_pixels:[/b] Returns the width and height of the canvas of the loaded Live2D model in pixels. - [Vector2] [b]origin_in_pixels:[/b] Returns the center position of the loaded Live2D model in pixels. - [float] [b]pixels_per_unit:[/b] Returns the [i]pixelsPerUnit[/i] of the loaded Live2D model.

method.name: get_cubism_motion_queue_entries
method.description: Legacy list of opaque motion-entry resources. Use the handle returned by start_motion to observe playback completion and cancellation.

method.name: get_expressions
method.description: Returns a list of [i]Expressions[/i] from the currently held Live2D model. The information obtained can be used as an argument for the [method GDCubismUserModel.start_expression] function.

method.name: get_hit_areas
method.description:
Gets information about [i]HitArea[/i] set in Live2D model. The elements of array are [Dictionary], and have elements id and name. id points to mesh element, so it can be used as a key for [method GDCubismUserModel.get_meshes].
You can implement interaction with Live2D model using this function and information obtained from [method GDCubismUserModel.get_meshes]. If you don't need advanced processing, you can easily use it by using [GDCubismEffectHitArea] class.

method.name: get_meshes
method.description:
Gets information about [ArrayMesh] of [MeshInstance] used in current Motion state. The keys this [Dictionary] holds are identical to names of [MeshInstance] generated by [GDCubismUserModel]. The information that can be obtained is internal [ArrayMesh]. It can be used in following way. [b]Example:[/b] [codeblocks] [gdscript] var dict_mesh: Dictionary = model.get_meshes() var ary_mesh: ArrayMesh = dict_mesh[art_mesh_name] var ary_surface: Array = ary_mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)
var mesh_vertex: PackedVector2Array = ary_surface[ArrayMesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] var mesh_tex_uv: PackedVector2Array = ary_surface[ArrayMesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] var mesh_index: PackedInt32Array = ary_surface[ArrayMesh.ARRAY_INDEX] [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] [b]CAUTION[/b] get_meshes is an experimental function added in v0.1. Please note that the specification may change or be deleted in the future.

method.name: get_motions
method.description: Returns a list of _Motions_ from the currently held Live2D model. The returned _Dictionary_ is _group_ and the number of motions contained in it. To enumerate all motions, write as follows. [b]Example:[/b] [codeblocks] [gdscript] var dict_motion = $GDCubismUserModel.get_motions() for group in dict_motion.keys(): for no in dict_motion[group]: print("group: %s, no: %d" % [group, no]) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_parameters
method.description: Gets a class to operate the currently held Live2D model.

method.name: get_part_opacities
method.description: Gets a class to operate the part transparency of the currently held Live2D model.

method.name: start_expression
method.description: Plays the specified [param expression_id].

method.name: start_motion
method.description: Plays the [i]Motion[/i] specified by [param group] and [param no].

method.name: start_motion_loop
method.description: Plays the [i]Motion[/i] specified by [param group] and [param no]. Specify this when you want to play repeatedly. If the [param loop] argument is [code]false[/code], it behaves the same as the [method GDCubismUserModel.start_motion] function.

method.name: stop_expression
method.description: Stops the currently playing [i]Expression[/i].

method.name: stop_motion
method.description: Stops the currently playing [i]Motion[/i].

members.member: By specifying a file with the [code]*.model3.json[/code] extension, you can load the Live2D model. As soon as you specify a file, it will be loaded immediately. if you want to switch the Live2D model, you can do so by simply specifying a new file. Prepared Cubism sources load through their imported resources. Use Project → Tools → Prepare Legacy Cubism Model, then reopen and save legacy scenes to retain their export dependencies. Unprepared sources retain raw-file loading; checked export requires a saved imported-resource bridge.
If set to [code]false[/code], it will not load [i]Expressions[/i] when loading the Live2D Model.
If set to [code]false[/code], it will not load [i]Motions[/i] when loading the Live2D Model.

Specify the maximum resolution for any individual mask required for the Live2D model. If set to 0, size of the mask will be relative to the source pixel resolution of the model's canvas. Mask resolution is also dynamically resized relative to the model's scale within its viewport.
Reducing the resolution can help conserve GPU memory, however reducing resolution too far can cause visual issues where masks are applied. For many, it's best to leave this at default and rely solely on the automatic scaling.
Specifies the control method for the currently held Live2D model.
Setting this parameter to [code]false[/code] disables physical calculations.
Specifies the playback method for the currently held Live2D model.

Setting this parameter to [code]false[/code] disables transparency calculations between drawing parts specified in the pose group. If you want to manually handle all transparency calculations, set this parameter to [code]false[/code].
Specifies the playback speed of the currently held Live2D model.

signal.name: model_ready
signal.description: Queued after a complete load. Superseded loads do not emit stale ready signals. Use queue_free to delete the model from a callback.

signal.name: model_failed
signal.description: Queued after a failed load has released partial resources. The dictionary contains code, path and message.

signal.name: motion_event
signal.description:
Called at the timing of the event time embedded in [i]Motion[/i]. [b]Example:[/b] [codeblocks] [gdscript] func _on_motion_event(value: String): print(value)
func _ready(): $GDCubismUserModel.motion_event.connect(_on_motion_event) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

signal.name: motion_finished
signal.description: Legacy no-argument signal queued after natural completion, outside SDK iteration. Use the motion handle's finished signal for all terminal reasons, including cancellation. Use queue_free for deletion inside callbacks.

constants.constant: Specify this when playing the [i]Motion[/i] specified by the [method GDCubismUserModel.start_motion] function. When this is specified, operations by [GDCubismParameter] cannot be performed.

Specify this when using the [GDCubismParameter] obtained by the [method GDCubismUserModel.get_parameters] function to operate the Live2D model. When this is specified, motion playback cannot be performed by the [method GDCubismUserModel.start_motion] function.
Native animation updates run through internal physics notifications. Use this when you want to interact with physical simulation.
Native animation updates run through internal process notifications.
No animation update process is performed. To process the animation, use the [method GDCubismUserModel.advance] function.
